core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for syntomic morphisms (proof lines 2044-2049).

Choose a surjective \'etale chart U \to X; by the same locality lemma it suffices to show U \to Z is syntomic, and from f' syntomic plus Z' \times_Z U \'etale over Z' \times_Z X conclude Z' \times_Z U \to Z' is syntomic (proof lines 2051-2059).
Conclude U \to Z is syntomic by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma applied to the covering {Z' \to Z} (proof lines 2059-2062).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Move syntomicity to the \'etale charts over Z and Z'.
Descend along the fpqc covering with the scheme-side lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof is the syntomic instance of the chart-reduction descent argument: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma for syntomic morphisms; syntomicity is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z', the latter because Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes.
